port.name: Television
port.description: Living Code for Television: complete native TOML palettes for search results, matches, previews, selections and mode indicators.

guide.installation:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/living-code-theme/television.git
cd television
```

```sh
mkdir -p "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/television/themes"
cp themes/*.toml "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/television/themes/"
```

Merge this into the existing `config.toml` in your Television config directory:

```toml
[ui]
theme = "living-code-night"
```

Restart `tv`. If you configured a different config directory, put `themes/` beside that `config.toml`.
guide.configuration: A theme file has flat color keys; `[ui]` belongs only in `config.toml`. Existing `[ui.theme_overrides]` entries override the installed palette, so remove conflicting values if the colors do not match. The port sets both foreground and background on selected results and every mode badge.
guide.compatibility: Targets Television’s documented flat TOML custom-theme API and all required fields in its `Theme` struct. The `send_to_channel_mode_fg` fallback in newer documentation is not needed by the pinned contract. Truecolor is recommended. Tests check the full required field set, native parsing, semantic colors and selected-row contrast.
